FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Harvest Market
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Fresh Harvest Market, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Harvest Market specializes in the retail of fresh fruits and vegetables, sourced primarily from local farmers and certified suppliers. Our operations prioritize food safety and quality, complying with all local health department regulations. We maintain rigorous temperature and humidity controls for all perishable inventory to ensure freshness and reduce spoilage risks. Our staff undergoes regular training in food handling protocols to minimize the risk of foodborne illnesses. We conduct supplier audits to verify compliance with food safety standards, enhancing the integrity of our supply chain. Additionally, we utilize a digital inventory management system, allowing for real-time monitoring and alerts for any temperature fluctuations, further safeguarding our products. Operating from 8 AM to 8 PM, we serve our community with a commitment to excellence and sustainability, engaging in local food safety initiatives to foster a healthy marketplace.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 01/15/2023, Cause: Increased temperature in refrigeration unit due to mechanical failure, Amount: $600.00, Status: Resolved. Loss dates: 03/22/2023, Cause: Spoilage of inventory due to power outage, Amount: $600.00, Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-security cash vault, Class B, UL-rated, monitored alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing with monitored surveillance and a trained watchperson during operating hours.
